title: HDFC Top 100 Fund - Key Information Memorandum (KIM) & SID

sections.content: The investment objective is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio invested predominantly (minimum 80%) in large cap companies. In accordance with SEBI circulars, large cap companies are the top 100 companies in India ranked by full market capitalization. Up to 20% may be held in non-large cap equities or debt.
Minimum initial investment is ₹100. Minimum monthly SIP is ₹100. The scheme is open-ended with zero statutory lock-in. Purchases and redemptions execute at cut-off NAV.
